name: Unreal Engine games
author: Cell
summary: Skips the startup movies that often hang under Wine and keeps Unreal games in game-style scrolling and display capture.
useWhen: An Unreal Engine game says DirectX 12 isn't supported, stutters on start, or opens at the wrong size.

notes: Unreal Engine 5 compiles shaders on first launch; the first minutes can stutter. It gets smooth after the shader cache is built.

diagnostics.title: Unreal could not start Direct3D
diagnostics.advice: Cell will try the other engine automatically (DXMT runs Unreal's -dx11 renderer).
